description: Generates the only product CSV allowed by MCP policy. It returns plain CSV text, not a downloadable file, and only includes the HGRWeb report columns: eBay item ID, sku, stock, cost price and selling price. Requires explicit productIds and confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested the limited HGRWeb-style product CSV.

productIds.description: Explicit visible Product Id / primary id values to include. Required; the MCP does not generate all-store product export files.

name: hgr_generate_limited_products_csv
title: Generate Limited Products Csv
